description: RUGGED, HEAVY-DUTY, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, READY FOR ANY CHALLENGE! The 2022 Ram 2500 Laramie Mega Cab is built for owners who expect far more than ordinary capability. Combining heavy-duty strength with premium comfort, this full-size pickup is equally at home towing a large fifth-wheel camper, hauling equipment to the jobsite, or serving as a refined long-distance cruiser. The spacious Mega Cab configuration adds an entirely different level of passenger comfort, making this truck especially desirable for families, contractors, and anyone who regularly spends long hours behind the wheel. Equipped with FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE, this Ram delivers outstanding confidence in rain, snow, muddy job sites, and challenging off-road terrain. Whether you're pulling a trailer, exploring back roads, or simply dealing with unpredictable weather, the drivetrain helps maximize traction while preserving the composed ride quality that has made Ram heavy-duty trucks favorites among truck buyers. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Ram's Heavy Duty lineup has earned an outstanding reputation by combining serious towing capability with one of the most comfortable cabins in the segment. While many heavy-duty pickups prioritize work above everything else, the Ram 2500 successfully blends commercial-grade strength with luxury-level refinement, making it just as enjoyable on daily commutes as it is on demanding work assignments. The Mega Cab is especially sought after because it offers one of the largest rear seating areas available in any pickup. Rear passengers enjoy exceptional legroom, generous storage solutions, and seating comfort that rivals many full-size luxury SUVs, making this configuration particularly attractive for families, traveling crews, and anyone who regularly carries adult passengers. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Automotive journalists consistently praise the Ram 2500 for its exceptionally comfortable ride, upscale interior, impressive diesel performance, and quiet highway manners. Reviewers have long regarded the Ram Heavy Duty lineup as one of the most refined trucks in its class without sacrificing the strength expected from a serious work truck. Kelley Blue Book consistently recognized the Ram Heavy Duty lineup among the strongest values in the heavy-duty truck segment. Widely praised by Car and Driver and MotorTrend for combining luxury-level comfort with genuine heavy-duty capability. Frequently recognized for one of the quietest and most refined interiors available in the heavy-duty pickup market. Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 43,045-mile mark, and it has some supplemental factory coverage remaining. Corrosion Perforation Limited Warranty -- protects against sheet metal corrosion resulting in perforation through October 4, 2027, regardless of mileage. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind for years to come. Standard Features Stepping up to the Laramie trim transforms the Ram 2500 from a capable work truck into a premium heavy-duty pickup. Leather seating surfaces, advanced technology, upgraded interior materials, heated front and rear seating, a heated steering wheel, premium audio, and numerous comfort features create an environment that's exceptionally comfortable whether you're heading across town or across the country. Unlike lower trims that focus primarily on utility, the Laramie delivers a balance of luxury and capability that appeals to buyers who need serious towing and hauling ability without sacrificing everyday refinement. Installed Options This Ram was generously equipped from the factory with desirable upgrades that further enhance both capability and comfort. Laramie Level B Equipment Group Ventilated front seats for year-round comfort. Rain-sensitive windshield wipers. Power-folding trailer-tow mirrors with memory and integrated auxiliary mirrors. Remote tailgate release. Heated second-row seats. Memory settings for the driver's seat, mirrors, and pedals. Automatic high-beam headlamps. SiriusXM 360L capability (subscription may be required). Power-adjustable pedals with memory. 6.7-Liter Cummins Turbo Diesel Engine Legendary Cummins turbo diesel performance delivering exceptional low-end torque, outstanding towing confidence, and impressive long-distance durability. Standalone Factory Options Power sunroof. Power deployable running boards. Uconnect 5 NAV with a 12-inch touchscreen display. Blind Spot Monitoring with Trailer Detection. Spray-in bedliner by Mopar. LED bed lighting. 220-amp alternator. Painted front and rear bumpers. Granite Crystal Metallic exterior paint. Leather-trimmed bucket seats. Customer Preferred Package 2HH. Night Edition appearance package. Aftermarket Items This Ram has been thoughtfully upgraded with quality aftermarket equipment that gives it an even more commanding appearance while expanding its capability. Heavy-duty aftermarket full-width front bumper with integrated bull bar and D-ring recovery points for increased front-end protection and off-road functionality. Fifth-wheel trailer hitch installed in the bed for heavy trailer towing. Aftermarket suspension lift providing additional ground clearance and a more aggressive stance. Fuel Clash aftermarket wheels. Mickey Thompson off-road tires designed for excellent traction on dirt, gravel, mud, and rocky terrain. Black textured fixed side steps providing easier entry into the lifted cabin. Mechanical Features Power comes from Ram's legendary 6.7-liter Cummins turbo diesel paired with a smooth-shifting 68RFE six-speed automatic transmission. Renowned for exceptional durability and tremendous low-end torque, this powertrain is engineered to confidently handle demanding towing assignments while remaining remarkably composed during everyday driving. The heavy-duty suspension, integrated trailer brake controller, and exhaust brake further inspire confidence when hauling substantial loads. FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE allows this truck to venture well beyond paved roads when work or recreation demands it. Combined with its lifted suspension, aggressive off-road tires, and upgraded recovery-ready bumper, this Ram is prepared for challenging terrain while still maintaining impressive highway comfort. Truck Capability Built on Ram's heavy-duty chassis and equipped with the legendary 6.7-liter Cummins Turbo Diesel, this 2500 Mega Cab is engineered to tackle demanding jobs with confidence. Based on the closest verified factory configuration, this truck offers an estimated maximum conventional towing capacity of approximately 19,000 pounds when properly equipped, with an estimated payload capacity of roughly 2,300-2,700 pounds. Exact ratings vary based on the certification label, axle ratio, and the completed aftermarket configuration. The 6'4'' cargo box provides an excellent balance between hauling capability and everyday maneuverability. Factory specifications include approximately: Bed Length: 76.3'' Bed Width: 66.4'' Width Between Wheel Wells: 51.0'' Cargo Box Depth: 20.2'' These dimensions make it easy to transport full-size building materials, motorcycles, ATVs, landscaping equipment, generators, toolboxes, and countless other work or recreational cargo. Factory towing equipment includes: Integrated trailer brake controller Tow hooks Class V receiver hitch Power-folding trailer tow mirrors Fifth-wheel preparation made even more useful by the installed aftermarket fifth-wheel hitch The professionally upgraded suspension lift, 22'' Fuel Clash wheels, aggressive Mickey Thompson off-road tires, heavy-duty front bumper, and installed fifth-wheel hitch give this Ram an even more capable appearance while improving ground clearance for off-road travel and jobsite use. Because these aftermarket upgrades may influence payload, towing, ride characteristics, and overall height, the exact ratings should be verified using the driver's door certification label for your specific towing application. Exterior Features The Night Edition gives this Ram an unmistakably bold presence by replacing much of the traditional brightwork with blacked-out accents that perfectly complement the Granite Crystal Metallic exterior. Combined with the aggressive stance created by the suspension lift, 22'' Fuel wheels, and Mickey Thompson off-road tires, this truck commands attention whether it's pulling into a jobsite or heading out for a weekend adventure. Practicality is just as impressive as its appearance. LED lighting improves nighttime visibility, the spray-in Mopar bedliner helps protect the cargo box from scratches and dents, and the power-deployable running boards automatically extend when the doors are opened before tucking neatly away while driving for improved ground clearance and a clean appearance. Interior Features Open the oversized Mega Cab doors and you'll immediately appreciate why this configuration has earned such a loyal following. The cavernous rear seating area provides exceptional legroom along with generous reclining seatbacks and additional interior storage, making long road trips significantly more comfortable for passengers while offering secure storage for valuable equipment behind the rear seats. Laramie's leather-trimmed bucket seats, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals with memory, and driver's seat memory system create a cabin that feels every bit as refined as many luxury SUVs. Whether you're commuting every day or spending hours towing across several states, this interior is designed to keep everyone comfortable mile after mile. Infotainment & Technology At the center of the dashboard is Ram's outstanding Uconnect 5 infotainment system, displayed through a massive 12-inch touchscreen that combines crisp graphics with fast response times and intuitive menus. Built-in navigation makes trip planning simple, while wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow compatible smartphones to integrate seamlessly for calls, music, messaging, and navigation. Additional technology includes a premium Alpine audio system with nine speakers and a subwoofer, Bluetooth connectivity, multiple USB charging ports, SiriusXM 360L capability (subscription may be required), voice recognition, and customizable digital information displays that keep important vehicle information easily accessible without distracting from the road ahead. Safety Features This Ram was engineered to help provide confidence whether it's traveling empty or towing a heavy trailer. Electronic Stability Control, Trailer Sway Damping, Roll Mitigation, Hill Start Assist, and an integrated trailer brake controller work together to improve stability when conditions become challenging. Blind Spot Monitoring with Trailer Detection is especially valuable when towing, helping monitor areas that become difficult to see with longer trailers attached. Front and rear ParkSense parking sensors, ParkView rear backup camera, rain-sensitive windshield wipers, automatic high-beam headlamps, tire pressure monitoring, and a comprehensive airbag system further contribute to making every trip safer and less stressful. ... and there's SO MUCH more! The combination of Ram's legendary Cummins diesel powertrain, the sought-after Mega Cab configuration, premium Laramie equipment, desirable factory options, and extensive aftermarket upgrades creates a heavy-duty pickup that's equally comfortable tackling demanding work, serious towing, and everyday driving. With a clean NO-ACCIDENT history and a configuration that would cost a substantial amount to duplicate today, this Ram stands out as an exceptionally capable and well-equipped truck. Life's too short to drive boring trucks--this Ram is ready to work hard, play harder, and look great doing it. Meet the 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ, a powerful work truck built for those who demand capability, comfort, and reliability in everything they do.

- Bluetooth connectivity and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto integration
- 4WD with Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package including off-road suspension and hill descent control
- Heated and cooled leather front seats with heated rear seats
- Heated steering wheel and multi-zone climate control
- Navigation system with backup and bed view cameras
- Remote start and keyless entry with push button start
- TOW package engineered for serious hauling
- Adaptive cruise control and trailer side blind zone alert
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM 360L
- Wireless phone projection and charging capability

This Silverado arrives with the confidence that comes from one previous owner and a clean Carfax history. The 6.6L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers the power necessary for demanding jobs while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency. The truck's exterior features a striking red finish complemented by chrome accents, including door handles, mirror caps, and a rear step bumper that enhance its professional appearance.

Inside, you'll find genuine leather seating surfaces with power adjustments, offering both comfort and support during long drives or workdays. The front bucket seats provide excellent positioning for the driver, while the heated rear seats ensure passengers remain comfortable in cooler weather. The heated steering wheel and advanced climate control system allow you to set your preferred cabin temperature with precision.

Technology plays a significant role in this Silverado's appeal. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System connects your devices seamlessly through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while SiriusXM satellite radio and the available navigation system keep you entertained and on course. Wireless charging and multiple USB ports ensure your devices stay powered throughout your travels.

Safety and capability are paramount in this truck's design. The backup camera, bed view camera with trailer provisions, and surround vision system provide visibility you need when maneuvering in tight spaces or monitoring your load. Adaptive cruise control, trailer side blind zone alert, and rear cross traffic alert work together to enhance your confidence on the road. The Z71 Off-Road Package includes off-road-tuned suspension, hill descent control, and skid plates protecting critical components during challenging terrain navigation.

The towing package combined with the truck's substantial frame makes this Silverado ready to handle serious hauling duties responsibly. Chrome recovery hooks up front provide additional security for winching operations when needed.

This 2024 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ represents a solid investment in a truck that balances work capability with daily driving comfort. We've completed a rigorous 40-point inspection to confirm its condition, and it includes a 6-month, 6,000-mile limited powertrain warranty for added peace of mind. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it can serve your needs.

Meet the 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali, a full-size pickup truck that combines premium craftsmanship with the capability to handle whatever you need to accomplish. This White Sierra 1500 Denali represents the height of luxury truck engineering, built on a foundation of proven performance and refined comfort.

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration
- Leather seating with 12-way power driver and passenger seat adjusters with lumbar support
- Power sunroof and moonroof
- Navigation System with integrated hitch guidance
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Rear backup camera with HD surround vision
- Rear backup sensors and ultrasonic front and rear park assist
- Trailering Package with integrated trailer brake controller and in-vehicle app
- Remote start and keyless entry with push-button start
- Heated and ventilated front seats with heated rear seating
- Running boards and chrome recovery hooks
- Adaptive suspension with hill descent control and auto-locking rear differential
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto capability
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning and Forward Collision Alert
- Heated steering wheel with wireless charging pad

The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers the power and traction you expect from a Sierra, achieving 15 MPG in the city and 19 MPG on the highway. This powertrain is engineered to provide both the muscle for towing and hauling, and the refinement expected in the Denali trim level.

Inside, the Denali cabin welcomes you with genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels. The leather-trimmed interior features heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear outboard seating, and dual-zone automatic climate control to ensure every occupant stays comfortable. The 12-way power-adjustable driver's seat with lumbar support and memory functions personalizes your driving position, while the floor-mounted center console offers convenient storage and organization.

Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout. The premium GMC Infotainment System provides easy access to navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow you to connect your smartphone without cables. OnStar and GMC Connected Services provide emergency support and vehicle diagnostics, while the Wi-Fi hotspot keeps passengers connected. Bluetooth hands-free calling and steering wheel audio controls let you stay focused on the road.

Safety features demonstrate GMC's commitment to protecting you and your passengers. Enhanced automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and rear cross traffic braking work together to help prevent accidents. Rear pedestrian detection, trailer side blind zone alert, and the integrated backup camera system provide comprehensive visibility in challenging situations. The Trailering Package includes an integrated trailer brake controller, hitch view camera, hitch guidance on the navigation display, and the in-vehicle trailering system app for confident towing operations.

From the 20-inch polished aluminum wheels to the signature Denali chrome grille and body-color bumpers, every detail reflects attention to quality and design. The spray-on bedliner with Denali logo protects your truck bed, while the running boards and chrome recovery hooks add both function and premium appearance. The power sliding rear window with rear defogger and rain-sensing wipers enhance convenience and safety.

This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali represents the complete package for those who demand luxury, capability, and dependability. Visit us today to experience this exceptional truck firsthand and discover why the Sierra Denali is the choice of discerning truck buyers.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 470 hp and 975 lb-ft of torque
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Z71 Off-Road Package with off-road suspension and Hill Descent Control
- Remote Start Package with theft deterrent system
- Convenience Package including 120-volt power outlets and LED cargo bed lighting
- Heated driver and passenger seats with heated steering wheel
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with SiriusXM and 360L
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- 10-way power driver seat with lumbar support
- LED fog lamps and automatic headlights
- Dual-zone automatic climate control
- Durabed pickup bed with EZ Lift power tailgate
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts

The Duramax diesel engine is engineered to deliver the torque you need for towing and hauling, while the 10-speed automatic provides smooth, efficient power delivery across any driving condition. Four-wheel drive gives you capability in challenging terrain and weather, backed by the Z71 Off-Road Package featuring Rancho shocks and skid plates that protect critical components.

Inside, the LT trim provides genuine comfort for long workdays and commutes. The Convenience Package adds practical touches like the 120-volt power outlets in the bed and cab, ideal for job site tools and equipment. Dual-zone climate control keeps driver and passenger comfortable regardless of conditions, while the heated steering wheel and seats provide welcome warmth during cold mornings.

The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, SiriusXM satellite radio, and smartphone integration. The 6-speaker audio system delivers clear sound for navigation and entertainment. Remote vehicle start means you can have the truck running and ready before you step outside.

Practical features throughout make daily use straightforward.
